body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one non-Critical physical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; the target may stand from Prone and move 2 units.

surges.html: The target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Imbuement
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: it begins voluntary movement while a Wound penalty is suppressed. Echo: ignore the first difficult space and resist 1 unit of forced movement during that movement.
